update_ratio.measurement: computed from the actual parameter transition
update_ratio.candidate: transition produced by the first optimizer.step attempt
update_ratio.committed: transition retained after any guard action

buggy_no_guard.semantics: optimizer.step consumes entry_lr; after the step install L(t)

buggy_failfast_guard.semantics: optimizer.step consumes entry_lr; install L(t); measure update; stop if ratio > tau
buggy_failfast_guard.guard: post-update detection; offending update is not rolled back

buggy_rescue_guard.semantics: candidate step consumes entry_lr; if ratio > tau restore exact pre-step model and optimizer state, install L(t), and replay the same gradients once
buggy_rescue_guard.committed_lr: L(t) if guard triggers, otherwise entry_lr
buggy_rescue_guard.guard: post-update detection with rollback and replay

stable_with_guard.semantics: install S(t) before optimizer.step; optimizer.step consumes S(t)
stable_with_guard.guard: monitoring only; no stop or rescue action

fixed_order_with_guard.semantics: install L(t) before optimizer.step; optimizer.step consumes L(t)
fixed_order_with_guard.guard: monitoring only; no stop or rescue action

single_bad_first_step_then_stable.semantics_step_1: do not install S(1); optimizer.step consumes initial LR 1.0; actual exit LR remains 1.0
single_bad_first_step_then_stable.semantics_step_ge_2: install S(t) before optimizer.step; optimizer.step consumes S(t)

pretrained_schedule.name: linear_warmup_linear_decay
pretrained_schedule.total_steps: T = number of optimizer steps over the frozen training run

safe_correct_order.semantics: install P(t) before optimizer.step; consume P(t)

late_schedule_no_guard.semantics: optimizer.step consumes entry_lr; install P(t) only after the update

single_bad_then_correct.semantics_step_1: first optimizer.step consumes the initial peak LR; no corrective schedule installation occurs before that transition
single_bad_then_correct.semantics_step_ge_2: install P(t) before optimizer.step and consume P(t)
single_bad_then_correct.purpose: isolate the effect of one bad first transition

update_guard_failfast.semantics: use late-schedule candidate transition; measure update ratio; if ratio > tau stop without rollback

update_guard_rescue.semantics: use late-schedule candidate transition; if ratio > tau restore exact pre-step model and optimizer state, install P(t), and replay the same gradients once
update_guard_rescue.committed_lr: P(t) if guard triggers, otherwise entry_lr

executed_lr_assertion.semantics: before optimizer.step assert that the LR currently about to be consumed equals P(t); on mismatch record the event and abort before any parameter update

rescue_restores: optimizer state including moments and step counters
state_restoration_contract.gradient_rule: replay uses the same already-computed clipped gradients; no second forward/backward pass
state_restoration_contract.required_identity_check: pre-candidate state must equal restored state before replay
